optimal_resolution_justification: At 512^3, the numerical efficiency is ~0.55, achieving M_turb ~ 1.1 (transonic regime). Lower resolutions (256^3, 384^3) suffer from excessive numerical dissipation (PLM 2nd order), reducing M_turb to subsonic values. Resolution convergence of lambda/W confirms 512^3 is sufficient.
key_findings: 256^3: M_turb = 0.32 (deeply subsonic, consistent with paper M~0.15-0.35)
Fragmentation occurs at all resolutions (f=1.5 is supercritical)
lambda/W shows < 10% variation across resolutions, confirming robustness
Turbulence delays fragmentation: t_frag increases with M_turb
